description: Hi! We're Orbital Vitals, a team from Sydney building HALO, a health copilot for astronauts on Moon and Mars missions. It learns each astronaut's own baseline, flags meaningful changes early, and gives clear offline guidance when Earth is too far to answer in time, grounded in NASA space-medicine research and real NASA solar-storm data. We'd love a UX/UI designer, data/ML person, and health advisor. All levels are welcome. We'll plan before the event. Message us; we'd love to hear from you!
